mapper.select: select s.*,s1.account from ( select s.method_api as method, s.class_api as clazz, MIN(s.create_date) as time, round(avg(s.time),0) as average from sys_log s group by s.method_api,s.class_api ) s join sys_log s1 on s1.method_api=s.method and s1.class_api=s.clazz and s1.create_date = s.time order by s.average desc
